import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors1 = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color=colors1)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Dog Registrations by District (Kreis)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
bars2 = ax2.barh(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors2)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(district_counts.index)
ax2.set_xlabel('Total Dog Registrations')
ax2.set_title('Dog Registrations by District', fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Dog Age Distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
# Filter out invalid ages and get age distribution
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] >= 0) & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 25)]
sns.histplot(data=age_data, x='AlterVHundNum', bins=25, ax=ax3, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
ax3.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontweight='bold')
ax3.axvline(age_data['AlterVHundNum'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Mean: {age_data["AlterVHundNum"].mean():.1f} years')
ax3.legend()

# Plot 4: Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Age Group
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create cross-tabulation of owner age and dog gender
gender_owner = pd.crosstab(df['AlterV10Lang'], df['SexHundLang'])
# Sort by the owner age groups logically
age_order = ['10- bis 19-Jährige', '20- bis 29-Jährige', '30- bis 39-Jährige', 
             '40- bis 49-Jährige', '50- bis 59-Jährige', '60- bis 69-Jährige',
             '70- bis 79-Jährige', '80- bis 89-Jährige', '90- bis 99-Jährige']
gender_owner = gender_owner.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in gender_owner.index])

gender_owner.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='white')
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Age Group', fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.93)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
